title: Deprecate legacy swatch sets and introduce token-linting pipeline
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Summary: Remove legacy swatch families (legacy-neutrals/legacy-accent) and replace with a single auditable token set and an automated linting + migration pipeline. Goal is to reduce token variance, prevent divergent palette copies in repos, and provide deterministic visual diffs for rollout across buttons, tables, and chart components.

Background: Over time we accumulated multiple near-duplicate swatch families across platform and product repos. This has created confusion during rollouts (component teams consuming slightly different hex values), higher design/engineering debt for theming, and intermittent accessibility regressions when palettes drifted. Engineering has requested a safe, automated migration path and a CI-level lint step to prevent new ad-hoc swatches.

Scope:
- Author canonical palette (semantic tokens) with clear mapping from legacy swatches.
- Provide codemods to migrate CSS/SCSS variables and JS token imports.
- Build a token-lint tool that runs in CI (enforces canonical token usage, flags custom hex values, checks contrast thresholds against WCAG 2.1 AA where applicable).
- Integrate visual regression checks (Storybook snapshots + Chromatic/Percy) for the first canary rollout across Button, Table row, and Line/Bar chart components.
- Publish migration guide, mapping table, and a design QA checklist.

Non-goals: Changing type scale or spacing system in this ticket (will be handled in DES-50111). This ticket focuses on color/token hygiene, tooling, and rollout for surface components only.

Acceptance criteria:
1) Canonical token JSON published in the design repo and referenced by the monorepo via package:design-tokens@stable.
2) Codemod script (node) that maps legacy tokens to new tokens for CSS/JS with >=80% success on trial run across ui-frontend repo.
3) Token-lint plugin added to CI build that fails when a file contains raw hex colors not in the canonical token list (exceptions opt-in via comment).
4) Visual regression baseline for buttons, table-rows, and primary charts created; engineering and design sign-off documented.

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: Third-party repos using deeply nested color variables may break. Mitigation: provide a 'compat' alias layer and run codemods as a pre-release step in those repos.
- Risk: Contrast threshold failures for edge cases (low-contrast accents). Mitigation: token-lint will surface and the migration guide will document appropriate fallback tokens and usage guidance.

Rollout plan:
Phase 1 (this ticket) - Canonical tokens + token-lint CI + codemod (canary on ui-frontend).
Phase 2 - Migrate other primary apps (console, docs) with eng support and visual QA cycles.
Phase 3 - Disable legacy tokens in CI; provide a 3-week grace period and then hard-fail.

Docs & artifacts: mapping table, migration guide, storybook examples, codemod repo, token-lint repo.
